1) README / quickstart
2) Code Spots categories: Entry Points, Core Logic, Configuration
3) concept.* and roadmap for active work
4) Run setup script / install deps before first commit

Ask in team chat if a bookmark is missing — add it to shared.json for the next person.

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: AI rules: clip vs memory vs settings
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
Three ways to influence AI behavior — not interchangeable:

1) AI Clip (Code Spots Commands): copy on click — you decide when the AI sees it.
2) Memory projection (Pro+): selected clips mirrored into AI workspace memory while enabled.
3) Cursor / Copilot user rules: global editor settings — not managed by Code Spots.

Copy-on-click is not automatic enforcement unless memory projection is on for that clip.
